correctness.rationale: From the frozen RESULT.md the two-zone backward equations D u″-(r+s)u+r u(0)=0 on (0,L/2) and D u″-(r+s)u+r=0 on (L/2,L), plus Neumann at 0, Dirichlet at L, give H_r(s)=(r cosh z+s)/(r cosh z+s cosh 2z), z=L sqrt((r+s)/D)/2. Fair independent renewal marks yield the exact pole equation H_r(Λ)cosh k=1; nonlattice renewal limits and differentiable steep SCGF justify the LDP. For r>0, H~(r/s)e^{-z}, so z+log(s/r)=|k|-log2+o(1) and the -2log|k| correction; Legendre transform gives coefficient L²/(16D). r=0 directly yields Λ=D k²/L², I_0=L² j²/(4D). Independent mpmath roots at (r,k)=(0.01,40),(0.01,160),(0.5,40),(0.5,160) show normalized Λ/(4Dk²/L²) increasing toward 1 and logarithm correction error decaying; this is finite corroboration, not proof.
